privacy: Files stay on your device. No uploads, code execution, or remote resources.
drop: Drop an IPYNB file here to export it
formats: Save a notebook as HTML, Markdown or a code script.
invalid: This file is damaged or does not have a readable notebook structure. Save a new copy from the original notebook application.
emptyFile: This file is empty. Choose a notebook with content.
resourceLimit: Your browser ran out of resources while opening this document. Close other tabs and try again.
encoding: This notebook is not valid UTF-8 text. Save a UTF-8 .ipynb copy from the original application.
localResources: Some attachments or local images are unavailable. Only resources included in this notebook can be displayed.
remoteResources: Remote images, styles, and fonts were blocked.
safePreview: Saved results may be out of date. Code is never executed. External links open only when selected.
missingReference: This internal reference could not be found in the document.
version: This notebook format version is not supported. Save it as notebook format 4 in the original application.
emptyCell: This cell has no source text.
noOutput: No output was saved for this cell. Nothing runs during export.
unsupportedCell: This cell type is not supported. Its saved source is shown as text.
unsupportedOutput: This saved output has no supported static representation.
interactive: Interactive widgets and JavaScript outputs are not run. An available static representation is shown instead.
renderingNotes: Notebook styles may differ. LaTeX equations remain as source text; audio and video are not played.
missingAttachment: This cell attachment is missing or cannot be displayed.
failed: The exported HTML could not be displayed completely. Its download is unavailable. Try another browser.
engineUnavailable: The conversion engine could not start. Reload the page or try a current browser.
fidelity: Export the saved cells of a local Jupyter notebook as standalone HTML, Markdown or a code script. Cell order is preserved. Nothing is uploaded or executed.
limitations: Saved outputs may be out of date. Widgets, scripts, remote resources, audio and video are not run or fetched. Unavailable content is identified; this is not a reproduction of every Jupyter layout or feature.
layoutNotice: HTML and Markdown include supported saved outputs. Formatting is rebuilt, and unavailable images or rich outputs are identified. LaTeX remains source text.
copyFailed: The text could not be copied. Select it manually or download the file.
markdownNotice: Markdown preserves readable cells and supported saved outputs. Tables may use safe HTML, and included images use embedded data URLs; support varies between Markdown applications.
codeNotice: Code export includes code cells in their original order. Markdown, raw cells and saved outputs are omitted. Notebook magics and shell syntax are kept as written and may need manual adjustment or the original notebook kernel.
unknownLanguage: The notebook language is missing or unrecognized. Code is saved as a TXT file.
noCode: This notebook contains no code cells. The code download is an empty file.
imageUnavailable: This included image could not be read. A placeholder is included instead.
